baselineDefinition: Historical comparison against SKRoot Lite patched boot on the recorded device. The build guard checks source shapes and inventory completeness. These observations do not certify other devices, current binaries or installed modules.

points.name: Built-in policy types
points.observation: Whether live policy contains ksu or ksu_file types
points.evidence: The recorded policy digest prefix f30637d9 matched the baseline; this provider does not reload policy.

points.name: Policy grants
points.observation: Whether application domains receive ksu_file grants
points.evidence: The historical policy comparison found no added grants.

points.name: Cross-domain policy grants
points.observation: Whether new allow rules grant access from untrusted_app to su
points.evidence: The provider does not add policy rules.

points.name: Policy query consistency
points.observation: Whether policy queries through different interfaces agree
points.evidence: The provider does not replace policy query responses.

points.name: SELinux status page integrity
points.observation: Whether the mapped selinuxfs status page faults unexpectedly
points.evidence: The provider does not replace the status mmap handler.

points.name: SELinux status mapping ABI
points.observation: Whether status mapping permissions and ABI match the stock implementation
points.evidence: The provider does not change the mapping ABI.

points.name: Policy load sequence
points.observation: Whether the policy load sequence number changes
points.evidence: The historical attempt did not reload policy.

points.name: SELinux state consistency
points.observation: Whether the status page and enforcing state agree
points.evidence: The recorded final enforcing state was 1 and passed the stability check.
points.note: The observer did not classify this point while status page[2] was 0 during the transient window.

points.name: Controlled policy contexts
points.observation: Whether ksu or Magisk contexts are recognized
points.evidence: The provider does not write those contexts.

points.name: Context parsing timing
points.observation: Paired A/B timing for attr/current context writes
points.evidence: The provider has no context pre-parser. A historical PATH deployment overlay was removed and confined to Normal mode.
points.note: UNRESOLVED: obtain paired clean-boot and post-attempt timing samples before classifying the result.

points.name: AVC query counts
points.observation: Whether AVC query counts in App Zygote differ from baseline
points.evidence: The provider does not hook AVC queries; denials during the transient window may affect cache state.
points.note: UNRESOLVED: sample independently after restoration completes.

points.name: Network link boundary
points.observation: Whether RTM_GETLINK exposes physical interface addresses
points.evidence: The permissive interval answered the query; one historical attempt recorded 1241 ms elapsed.
points.note: The boundary returns to ENFORCED after restoration; the transient exposure remains part of this provider's scope.

points.name: Network neighbour boundary
points.observation: Whether RTM_GETNEIGH returns the neighbour table
points.evidence: The historical permissive interval answered the query.

points.name: Kernel supercall interface
points.observation: Whether syscall 45 exposes KernelPatch supercall timing
points.evidence: The recorded baseline used SKRoot Lite patches rather than KernelPatch.
points.note: A different deployed kernel requires its own baseline.

points.name: Shared executable dirty pages
points.observation: Whether executable system-library mappings report Shared_Dirty
points.evidence: The historical libc++ comparison recorded six executable mappings with Shared_Dirty=0 KB after content restoration, readback and eviction; native restore failures=0.
points.note: Dirty pages may remain observable before eviction completes.

points.name: Manager manifest traits
points.observation: Whether the APK declares zygotePreloadName and useAppZygote services
points.evidence: MapleSU implements IKsuInterface without using the app_zygote carrier.

points.name: Process lifetime
points.observation: Process group, session and parent-process changes
points.evidence: The root executor can briefly reparent to init; teardown checks UID and command-line identity.

points.name: Runtime environment
points.observation: Kernel localversion, late kallsyms loading and jbd2 loop changes
points.evidence: The recorded provider path did not load a jbd2 loop or change localversion.

points.name: Storage layout
points.observation: Whether /data/local/tmp and /data use different filesystem types
points.evidence: The recorded provider path did not add mounts.
points.note: The historical device contained /data/adb; its origin remained unverified.

points.name: KeyMint authorization
points.observation: Whether KeyMint rejects disallowed key usage
points.evidence: The provider does not modify keystore or KeyMint.

points.name: Cross-process SELinux attributes
points.observation: Whether another process's /proc/<pid>/attr/current can be opened
points.evidence: The historical permissive interval allowed the read; the restored state denied it.
points.note: The transient exposure follows the enforcing state.

points.name: Anonymous executable mappings
points.observation: Whether the provider creates anonymous executable mappings
points.evidence: The provider's recorded modifications used file-backed mappings.

points.name: Kernel release suffix
points.observation: Whether uname release contains -dirty
points.evidence: The historical kernel release ended in -4k.
